label: Which would you rather have received for this prompt?
help: Judge the whole clip, picture and sound, against the prompt in the brief. Pick 'same' when you would not care which one you got; you do not have to find a difference. Two different samples always differ somewhere, so the question is whether it matters.

label: Audio, only if you listened
help: Clearer, better level, better synced with the picture. Use Hear above to play each half's sound.

label: Why, in a line (optional)
help: Name the defect and the clip it is on: 'Clip 2's sign text melts by the end.' Skip it when the two are the same.

label: Something is broken in one or both clips
help: Garbage, a hard cut, a frozen figure, missing or desynced audio. Leave off if nothing is.
